prompt:
Look at the time-series table in the image. It shows a ledger-style table with one Name column, several year columns in chronological order, strong horizontal rules, and minimal vertical separators. Read the named row over time and report the requested integer result. Read the consecutive yearly values for row Root from 2022 through 2026. What is their sum?
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence rule: set "evidence" to an array containing the ordered queried year-cell bounding boxes from the start year through the end year.
Answer rule: set "answer" to the exact integer temporal result.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236],[488,180,600,236]],"answer":29}
